01
Documents & Process
penalty clause
penalidade contratual
A financial consequence applied when one party fails to meet the contract terms — such as late delivery or quality failure.
02
Documents & Process
payment terms
condições de pagamento
The agreed rules about when and how a buyer will pay the seller — for example, 30 days after the invoice date.
03
Documents & Process
force majeure
força maior
A contract provision that frees both parties from obligations when extraordinary events — such as disasters or conflicts — make fulfilment impossible.
04
Logistics & Operations
acknowledge
confirmar o recebimento / acusar o recibo
To formally confirm that a document was received and understood. 'Please acknowledge receipt of this PO.'
05
Grammar & Usage
supposed to
era para / devia
Fixed expression for plans, agreements, or expectations. Not for personal opinions.
""The delivery was supposed to arrive on Friday.""
06
Legal & Contracts
Non-conforming goods
Produtos Não Conformes
Goods that do not meet the specifications, quality standards, or requirements defined in the contract or purchase order. The buyer has the right to reject non-conforming goods and request replacement or a price reduction.
07
Grammar & Usage
must
deve / é obrigado a
Strong obligation — a rule, legal requirement, or non-negotiable condition.
""All invoices must include the PO number.""
08
Logistics & Operations
stockout
ruptura de estoque
When stock reaches zero and production or sales cannot continue. Every day of stockout has a direct financial cost.
09
Documents & Process
quotation
cotação / orçamento formal
A formal document from a supplier stating the price, quantity, and conditions under which they will sell their goods.
10
Logistics & Operations
resubmit
reenviar / submeter novamente
To send a corrected document again after an error was found. 'Please resubmit the invoice with the correct unit price.'
11
Legal & Contracts
Scope of supply
Escopo de Fornecimento
The precise definition of what the supplier is responsible for delivering — including goods, services, documentation, packaging, and installation if applicable. A well-defined scope prevents disputes about what was and was not included in the contract price.
12
Documents & Process
Incoterm
incoterm
Internationally recognised trade terms that define where responsibility transfers from seller to buyer, and who pays for shipping and insurance.
13
Logistics & Operations
vessel
navio / embarcação
A ship used for transporting cargo. 'We have confirmed vessel booking' = space on the ship is reserved.
14
Legal & Contracts
Arbitration
Arbitragem
A private dispute resolution process where a neutral third party (arbitrator) makes a binding decision instead of a court. Common in international contracts because it avoids the complexity of litigating across different legal systems. The ICC (International Chamber of Commerce) is a leading arbitration institution.
15
Documents & Process
clause
cláusula
A specific condition or requirement written into a contract or agreement.
16
Logistics & Operations
reorder
reabastecer / fazer novo pedido
To place a new purchase order for a product that is running low. 'We need to reorder HX-44 immediately.'
17
Quality & Compliance
compatibility
compatibilidade
Whether a component will work correctly with the buyer's existing equipment or system.
18
Quality & Compliance
inspection
inspeção
A physical check of goods — either at the factory before shipping (outgoing) or at the warehouse on arrival (incoming).
19
Logistics & Operations
invoice
fatura
A document from the supplier requesting payment for goods delivered. Must match the PO and GRN to be processed.
20
Legal & Contracts
Request for Quotation (RFQ)
Pedido de Cotação
A formal document sent by a buyer to one or more suppliers asking them to provide a price and delivery conditions for specific goods or services. It is not an order — it is a request for information.
21
Legal & Contracts
Confidentiality clause
Cláusula de Confidencialidade
A contract clause that prohibits one or both parties from disclosing sensitive information — such as pricing, technical specifications, or business plans — to third parties. Also known as an NDA (Non-Disclosure Agreement) when it is a standalone document.
22
Legal & Contracts
Liability cap
Limite de Responsabilidade
A contractual limit on the maximum financial compensation one party can claim from the other. Suppliers often propose low liability caps to protect themselves from large claims. Buyers should always check if the cap covers the full value of the order — and negotiate upward if necessary.
23
Logistics & Operations
freight
frete / carga
The goods being transported, or the cost of transporting them. 'Freight costs' = the price of shipping.
24
Grammar & Usage
should
deveria / acho que
Use for advice or personal opinion. Not for agreements or contracts.
""I think we should ask for better payment terms.""
25
Logistics & Operations
warehouse
armazém / depósito
The physical location where goods are stored after arrival and before being used in production or distributed.
26
Legal & Contracts
Net 30 / Net 60
Pagamento em 30 / 60 dias
Standard payment terms meaning the buyer must pay within 30 (or 60) days of the invoice date. Net 60 is common in B2B procurement and gives the buyer more time to manage cash flow. Suppliers may offer early payment discounts (e.g. 2/10 Net 30 = 2% discount if paid within 10 days).
27
Legal & Contracts
Governing law
Lei Aplicável / Foro
The jurisdiction whose laws will be used to interpret the contract and resolve disputes. In international procurement, this is critical — if a dispute goes to court orarbitrationA private dispute resolution process — a neutral arbitrator decides instead of a court. / Processo privado de resolução de disputas — um árbitro neutro decide em vez de um tribunal., the governing law determines the outcome. Always check with legal before accepting a foreign governing law.
28
Grammar & Usage
certificate of conformance
certificado de conformidade
A document from the supplier confirming goods meet the agreed specifications.
""Every batch is supposed to come with a certificate of conformance.""
29
Quality & Compliance
tolerance
tolerância
The acceptable range of variation in a measurement. E.g. ±0.05mm means the part can be 0.05mm bigger or smaller than the target.
30
Logistics & Operations
batch
lote
A group of products made in the same production run. Each batch has a unique reference for traceability — critical in chemicals and regulated industries.
31
Documents & Process
procurement
compras / suprimentos
The full process of finding, evaluating, and buying goods or services for a business.
32
Documents & Process
lead time
prazo de produção e entrega
The total time between placing an order and receiving the goods.
33
Logistics & Operations
specification
especificação técnica
The exact technical requirements for a product — dimensions, materials, purity, tolerances. The supplier must meet every point.
34
Documents & Process
MOQ (Minimum Order Quantity)
quantidade mínima de pedido
The smallest quantity a supplier is willing to sell in a single order.
35
Documents & Process
Purchase Order (PO)
ordem de compra
A formal document issued by a buyer to a supplier, confirming the purchase of specific goods at an agreed price and quantity.
36
Documents & Process
purchase agreement
contrato de fornecimento
A formal legal document that defines the terms of an ongoing supply relationship between a buyer and a supplier.
37
Legal & Contracts
Time is of the essence
O prazo é essencial / fundamental
A legal phrase used in contracts meaning that meeting the deadline is a fundamental requirement, not a guideline. If a contract contains this phrase, a supplier who delivers even one day late can be heldin breach of contractWhen a party fails to fulfil a legal obligation under a contract. / Quando uma parte deixa de cumprir uma obrigação legal prevista em contrato..
38
Legal & Contracts
Warranty
Garantia
A supplier's formal commitment that goods will be free from defects for a defined period. The warranty period, start date (from delivery, installation, or first use), and what it covers are all negotiable and must be clearly specified in the contract.
39
Legal & Contracts
In breach of contract
Em descumprimento contratual
When a party fails to fulfil one or more of its contractual obligations. A breach can be minor (partial non-performance) or material (serious failure that entitles the other party to terminate and claim damages). Late delivery, non-conforming goods, and failure to pay are common examples.
40
Documents & Process
RFQ (Request for Quotation)
pedido de cotação formal
A document sent to suppliers asking them to provide a price and delivery details for specific goods or services.
41
Documents & Process
amendment
aditivo / alteração de contrato
A formal written change made to an existing contract or purchase order after it has been signed.
42
Grammar & Usage
Bill of Lading (B/L)
Conhecimento de Embarque
A legal shipping document required for customs clearance at the destination port.
""Hua Li was supposed to send the B/L within 24 hours of shipment.""

01
Documents & Process
The contract included a _______ stating that for every day of late delivery, the supplier would pay 0.5% of the order value.
Clue It's a specific clause in the agreement — it protects the buyer when the supplier doesn't deliver on time.
02
Documents & Process
Before signing the PO, Carolina negotiated the _______ — she pushed for Net 60 instead of the supplier's standard Net 30.
Clue This defines when and how the buyer will pay — it's one of the first things discussed in any deal.
03
Documents & Process
When the port strike made it impossible to ship the goods, Hua Li invoked the _______ clause and suspended the delivery without penalty.
Clue It covers extraordinary events outside anyone's control — pandemics, natural disasters, strikes.
04
Logistics & Operations
Please _______ receipt of this Purchase Order by replying to this email — we need written confirmation before production begins.
Clue A simple but formal verb — you're confirming that you received something. Common in procurement emails.
05
Grammar & Usage
The Bill of Lading was _______ arrive by Monday, but the freight forwarder sent it on Wednesday — two days late.
Clue Use this when something was planned or agreed — not your opinion, but a specific expectation.
06
Legal & Contracts
The quality team rejected the shipment after the inspection — the batch was classified as _______ because the dimensions were outside the agreed tolerance.
Clue This is a formal term for products that don't match the agreed specifications.
07
Grammar & Usage
According to Clause 4.2, all invoices _______ include the Purchase Order number — no exceptions, or Finance will reject them.
Clue This is a strong obligation with no flexibility — a rule, not a recommendation.
08
Logistics & Operations
Production stopped for three days because the warehouse ran out of the component — a _______ that could have been avoided with better planning.
Clue It happens when inventory reaches zero and demand can't be met. Bad for production.
09
Documents & Process
After receiving the RFQ, Hua Li sent a formal _______ with unit price, lead time, MOQ, and payment terms — everything Althea needed to make a decision.
Clue This is the supplier's formal response to a price request — not yet a commitment, but a structured offer.
10
Logistics & Operations
Finance rejected the invoice because it was missing the PO number. Kevin had to correct it and _______ it within 24 hours.
Clue When something is sent back because it's incorrect, you need to do this — send it again, properly.
11
Legal & Contracts
Before signing, both parties reviewed the _______ carefully — it listed every item, service, and document the supplier was responsible for delivering.
Clue This defines exactly what is included in a contract — and more importantly, what is not.
12
Documents & Process
The PO specified FOB Shanghai as the _______ — meaning Hua Li was responsible for the goods until they were loaded onto the vessel.
Clue These are international trade terms that define where responsibility transfers from seller to buyer.
13
Logistics & Operations
The goods left Shanghai on the _______ MV Pacific Star on 18 November — the Bill of Lading was issued the same day.
Clue The ship that carries the goods across the ocean in international trade.
14
Legal & Contracts
The contract specified that any dispute would be resolved through _______ in Singapore, not through the courts.
Clue A private process for resolving legal disputes outside of court — faster and more confidential.
15
Documents & Process
Carolina highlighted the liability _______ on page 7 — it limited the supplier's financial exposure to 30% of the contract value.
Clue A specific condition or requirement written into a contract. Contracts are made up of many of these.
16
Logistics & Operations
When the stock level dropped below 200 units, the ERP system automatically triggered a _______ request to Hua Li.
Clue When inventory is running low, you do this — you place a new order to replenish the stock.
17
Quality & Compliance
Before approving the new component, the engineering team tested its _______ with the existing assembly — it had to fit perfectly.
Clue Whether two parts, systems, or materials work correctly together without modification.
18
Quality & Compliance
Every incoming shipment goes through a quality _______ before the goods are accepted into the warehouse and the invoice is released for payment.
Clue A formal check to verify that goods match the specifications agreed in the contract.
19
Logistics & Operations
The _______ arrived three days after the goods, but Finance couldn't process it because it was missing the PO number and the delivery date.
Clue The supplier's payment request — it has to match the PO and the goods receipt to be approved.
20
Legal & Contracts
Carolina sent a _______ to five suppliers, asking for unit price, lead time, and MOQ for 10,000 units of component HX-114.
Clue The first formal step in buying — you send this document to ask suppliers for their best offer.
21
Legal & Contracts
The purchase agreement included a _______ preventing both parties from sharing pricing, specifications, or contract terms with competitors.
Clue A section in the contract that protects sensitive business information from being shared outside.
22
Legal & Contracts
After negotiation, both sides agreed on a _______ of 100% of the annual contract value — limiting how much either party could claim in damages.
Clue A contractual limit on the maximum amount one party can be required to pay if something goes wrong.
23
Logistics & Operations
The _______ cost from Shanghai to Santos was USD 1,800 per container — a significant addition to the unit price that Carolina had not included in her budget.
Clue The cost and process of transporting goods from one place to another — usually by sea, air, or road.
24
Grammar & Usage
In my opinion, the legal team _______ review any contract above USD 50,000 before it is signed — it's not required, but it's good practice.
Clue Use this for advice or personal recommendations — not for agreements or obligations.
25
Logistics & Operations
The goods arrived at the _______ on Friday morning, but the receiving team was short-staffed — the incoming inspection wasn't completed until Monday.
Clue The physical facility where goods are stored between arrival and production or distribution.
26
Legal & Contracts
Hua Li's standard payment terms were _______, but Carolina negotiated _______ — giving Althea two months to pay after receiving the invoice.
Clue Payment terms that define how many days the buyer has to pay after the invoice date.
27
Legal & Contracts
The contract specified Brazilian law as the _______ — meaning any legal dispute would be interpreted under Brazilian legislation.
Clue The legal system that controls how a contract is interpreted if there is ever a dispute.
28
Grammar & Usage
Each shipment was supposed to come with a _______ signed by Hua Li's quality manager — confirming that the goods met Althea's specifications.
Clue A formal document from the supplier that proves the goods match the agreed technical requirements.
29
Quality & Compliance
The specification allowed a _______ of ±0.05mm — any component outside this range would be classified as non-conforming and returned.
Clue The acceptable range of variation in a measurement or specification — how much difference is still acceptable.
30
Logistics & Operations
The quality team identified a defect in _______ #HX-2024-114 — all 500 units produced in that production run had the same dimensional issue.
Clue A group of products made together in one production run — they share the same quality characteristics.
31
Documents & Process
_______ is much more than buying — it includes supplier selection, contract negotiation, quality control, and relationship management.
Clue The full strategic process of acquiring goods and services — from identifying a need to final payment.
32
Documents & Process
Hua Li's standard _______ for this component was 45 days — Carolina had to plan her production schedule around that window.
Clue The total time between placing an order and receiving the goods — critical for production planning.
33
Logistics & Operations
The engineering team sent a 12-page technical _______ to Hua Li — every dimension, material, and tolerance was described in detail.
Clue A detailed technical document that describes exactly what the product must look like and how it must perform.
34
Documents & Process
Hua Li's _______ was 5,000 units per order — too high for Althea's current production volume, so Carolina negotiated it down to 2,000.
Clue The smallest quantity a supplier is willing to sell in a single order — going below this isn't allowed.
35
Documents & Process
Once the quotation was approved, Carolina issued a formal _______ — locking in the price, quantity, delivery date, and payment terms.
Clue A legally binding document that confirms the purchase — once issued, both sides are committed.
36
Documents & Process
After three years of working together, Althea and Hua Li signed a _______ covering all orders for the next two years — including pricing, quality standards, and penalty conditions.
Clue A long-term contract that governs all transactions between buyer and supplier over a defined period.
37
Legal & Contracts
The contract included the phrase '_______ ' — making it legally clear that any delay in delivery would be treated as a breach.
Clue A legal phrase that makes punctuality a formal requirement — delays are not just inconvenient, they're a violation.
38
Legal & Contracts
The purchase agreement included a 12-month _______ — if any component failed within that period, Hua Li had to replace it at no extra cost.
Clue A guarantee from the supplier that the product will work as promised for a defined period.
39
Legal & Contracts
After missing three consecutive delivery deadlines, Hua Li was formally declared _______ — and Althea had the right to terminate the agreement.
Clue When one party fails to fulfill their legal obligations under the contract — it can trigger penalties or termination.
40
Documents & Process
The _______ was sent to three approved suppliers on Monday — responses were due by Friday, and any quotation missing the lead time would be disqualified.
Clue Short for Request for Quotation — the formal document that starts the price inquiry process.
41
Documents & Process
After the supplier requested a price revision, both parties signed an _______ to the original PO — officially updating the unit price from USD 4.20 to USD 4.50.
Clue A formal written change to an existing contract or PO — it has to be signed by both parties to be valid.
42
Grammar & Usage
Without the _______, customs clearance at Santos port was impossible — Carolina had to wait two extra days for Hua Li to send the original document.
Clue The essential shipping document that proves ownership and authorizes customs clearance at the destination port.
